season_awards_and_stats#aw7.evidence: The mechanism stage now exists. Catalog season_awards_and_stats.mechanism_review stage s4 'Jack Adams coach-level choice model (KXNHLADAMS)' takes input_ids nhl.coach_expectation_delta, nhl.award_vote_share_model, nhl.team_season_points_distribution, nhl.award_voting_rules and nhl.ratings, and runs a softmax over about 32 coaches averaged over the season simulation. nhl.coach_expectation_delta.measurement holds the input_patches text: an in-house P_exp, a conditional logit with b1..b3, a rank-ordered logit on the NHLBA top 3, and 'no archived preseason projection is required'. nhl.award_vote_share_model.measurement has a 'Coach branch (Jack Adams, NHL Broadcasters' Association electorate, 5-3-1 ...)'. Both inputs are in the archetype inputs list. Facts checked: series_assignment puts KXNHLADAMS in season_awards_and_stats, and the contract_rules_sample KXNHLADAMS-27-TMCL tie rule is $1/N. NHL.com confirms the NHLBA electorate and the 2026 result, Cooper 226 to Ruff 223. Minor leftover wording that does not change the fix: the input's label and mechanism still say 'preseason projection'/'preseason-projected value'. Stage s2 still says 'what a preseason projection predicted'. The required_data dataset 'Team standings, points percentage and preseason projections' still asks for a 'preseason projection frozen before the season' from MoneyPuck or Evolving-Hockey (paid) for coach_expectation_delta. award_vote_share_model carries audit_flag DUPLICATE of nhl.award_voting_rules, and that input's mechanism does not mention the NHLBA.

season_futures#sf6.evidence: Only partly fixed. The review stage season_futures s5 now lists nhl.standings_stakes and nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing in input_ids and adds them to situational_schedule_motivation coverage. But the catalog archetype season_futures.inputs contains neither of them, no season_futures required_data entry has them in feeds_inputs, and the season_futures input_audit has no entry for either. So the wiring exists only as stage prose. The patched nhl.standings_stakes.measurement is also defective. It fits the tanking regression on 'team-games 2005-06 onward', but it defines the lottery-value covariate only for '3 draws 2016-2020; 2 draws with 10-spot move-up cap from 2021, worst team 18.5%'. The 2005-06 to 2015-16 formats (one draw with a 4-spot move cap, then weighted odds from 2013) are not defined, so that covariate does not exist for about half the sample. The 2021 parameters are also wrong: NHL.com gives Buffalo 16.6% in 2021 because of the Seattle-adjusted odds, and 18.5% applies from 2022. The KXNHLRECORDWORST rules (league tiebreakers, then 1/N dead heat) and its season_futures assignment are correct.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate#p5.evidence: nhl.goalie_start_forecast.measurement now separates 'Regular season:' from a 'Playoff branch (no back-to-backs; rotation rules do not apply)'. The branch is a logistic starter-change hazard on the game-g save pct gap, a pulled flag, goals allowed, backup-minus-incumbent GSAx/60, an elimination flag and an injury flag. It is fitted on 2005-06+ playoff logs (NHL API game type 3). This matches input_patches NHL_a.json. The input is in catalog unregistered_archetypes.playoff_series_aggregate.inputs (secondary, with a playoff starter-change rationale) and in stage s1 input_ids, whose description now refers to the playoff branch. The NHL_new required_data 'Goalie performance and lineup status' feeds it. It was also added to season_futures stage s4 input_ids, which covers KXNHLSERIES/EAST/WEST/NHL. Minor gaps: it is not in the season_futures.inputs list, and the free_sources endpoint '/game-log/now' does not pull past playoff (type 3) logs. Nothing in the records still describes the input as regular-season only.
